text:
Sasha: Hey all, quick follow-up from the weekend outage. I want to tighten postmortem follow-ups so remediations don't drift. Proposal below.
Kevin: yes please. we lost track after the RCA was drafted.
Maria: what does "tighten" look like concretely?
Sasha: Draft cadence: T0 = incident declared. T+24h = assign remediation owner + short RCA summary. T+72h = remediation plan with owners and ETAs. T+14d = verification + test evidence. T+30d = closure review + recurrence analysis.
Aj: Add automated reminders at T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. OpsTracker should ping owners and post a status snapshot.
OpsTracker: Scheduled reminders enabled for thread 1870101234: T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. Will post ownership summary and outstanding items.
Priya: IC rotation idea: monthly rotation among on-call leads. If IC is unavailable, fallback to previous on-call or senior on-call. Require IC handoff note in-thread with a short template.
Kevin: drop the template inline?
```
IC Handoff Template:
- Outgoing IC: name
- Incoming IC: name
- Incident summary (2-3 bullets)
- Open actions: owner + ETA
- Blockers / follow-ups
- Next check-in (datetime, timezone)
```
Sasha: Also: remediation owner must be distinct from IC. IC coordinates, owner is accountable for closure.
Maria: For recurring incidents, flag T+30 review as "pattern review" and include logs+signatures. Research/Infra can tag similar incidents.
Aj: Suggest weekly 15m remediation sync for items older than 7 days (optional but helps unblock).
Priya: External comms: maintain status posts until T+72h, then consolidated postmortem summary after closure. Legal/Comms cc'd for regulated customers.
Kevin: Can we surface SLAs? e.g., P1: ack in 12h, mitigation in 72h, full remediation targeted in 7-14d depending on scope. Mark as guidance for first 90 days.
Sasha: I'll draft a single-page runbook: cadence, IC rota, acceptance criteria for closing actions (owner confirmation, test evidence, doc updated). Will post to #eng-oncall for pilot signups.
Maria: OpsTracker: can you create a board view filtered by incident tag so owners see all outstanding items?
OpsTracker: Created board "Incident Remediations" and synced items for incidents tagged #1870 and newer. Board filter: tag:incident AND status:open.
Priya: One more: require owners to set an ETA when they accept an action; OpsTracker should mark items stale if no progress for 7 days.
Aj: I'll volunteer for the pilot rota next month.
Kevin: me too.
Sasha: Great. If others want in, reply in thread. I'll post the draft runbook by EOD tomorrow and enable the OpsTracker reminders for the pilot incidents. Thanks!
